text: Crypto.com's corporate chain ends offshore: the OCC's conditional trust-bank approval records that Foris Holdings KY Limited, a Cayman Islands corporation, owns Foris DAX MT Ltd. (Malta), which is described as the top-tier holding company for the Crypto.com family of companies. Ownership is entirely private, with no state stake, albeit in a Cayman/Malta structure that is opaque below the top tier. Human-rights relevance is crypto-market and licensing conduct across many jurisdictions.
